inputs.root_cause: GAP-020: only ipynb and nrrd had an implementation-evidence ledger. safetensors' 86 obligations had never been classified against source symbols or test selectors, so neither the exact-obligation reconciler nor the proof-requirement audit could run for it.

execution_steps: 1. Generalized the one-off IPYNB generator into tools/ff6/build_evidence_ledger.py, warranted by the directive's 'at least two accepted format slices prove a repeated need' rule -- four formats need identical work.

2. Put the capability-to-module mapping in a reviewable data file (shared/format-contracts/ledger-maps/safetensors.yaml) rather than in the script, since it is human judgement about what implements what.
3. Built the ledger with the GAP-018 shipped-namespace filter applied from the start: only the 17 test files importing format_factory.safetensors may supply selectors.
4. Result: 86 obligations, all partial, 0 missing -- every capability mapped to at least one shipped-namespace test file, a better starting position than IPYNB had.
5. Ran the proof-requirement audit: 35 mechanically clean, 51 with dimension shortfalls, and no shadow, skipped, or missing-test findings.
6. Recorded the suite result honestly rather than as a clean PASS -- see result and evidence.suite_truth below.
tests_run: python -m tools.ff6.build_evidence_ledger --format-id safetensors  # 86 obligations, 86 partial, 0 missing
python -m tools.ff6.audit_proof_requirements --format-id safetensors  # 35 clean, 51 dimension shortfalls

evidence.suite_truth: 385 passed, 4 failed, 1 skipped in the shared dev venv. The 4 failures are the known GAP-002 shadow-package name collision: the deprecated safetensors.safetensors_codec package collides with the official safetensors distribution, so the official-interop tests cannot resolve both in one environment. They pass in an isolated wheel-install venv. They are NOT counted as passing here, and the declared result says so rather than claiming PASS.
evidence.obligations_moved_note: Zero. Mapping obligations to symbols and selectors is not proving them. Every entry is partial at most, and none has completed its proof-requirement audit.
